whatItIs: The feast of St. Mary of Zion on Hidar 21, one of the largest celebrations of the year, centred on Aksum.
whyItMatters: It is connected to the Ark of the Covenant, which Ethiopian tradition holds was brought to Aksum. Mary is honoured as the true Ark, who carried Christ.
whatPeopleDo: Pilgrims travel to Aksum for the celebration
Churches dedicated to St. Mary of Zion hold special services
It falls inside Tsome Nebiyat, so the fast continues
